title: Marguerite and the Will
author: Elodie Delacroix
blurb: Vesper Okafor, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
